q: Which pulp and paper mills have CCTS targets, and in which sub-sectors?
title: CCTS pulp and paper targets
short: 51 pulp and paper mills have targets under the October 2025 rules, in four sub-sectors: integrated plants, recycled fibre or imported pulp plants, agro based plants and speciality paper plants. Each mill has a 2023-24 baseline and targets for 2025-26 and 2026-27.
audience: Paper mill teams and their suppliers

ul: RCF based plants or imported pulp.
Registration number PNPOE plus a serial and state code.
Baseline equivalent product output for 2023-24, in tonnes.
Baseline intensity and targets, in tonnes CO2e per tonne of equivalent product.
Example: one Maharashtra speciality paper plant, baseline 1.7547, target 1.7275 for 2025-26 and 1.6567 for 2026-27.
